claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the powder effectively prevents and treats heat rash and prickly heat.
Many users praise it for keeping them dry and cooling in hot climates and during sweaty activities.
Several reviewers say it outperforms name-brand powders and is a good value.
The scent is generally liked, though some find certain scents strong or overpowering.
A few reviewers mention drawbacks such as a stinging sensation on sensitive areas, packaging/spill issues, or that a medicated powder works better for severe cases.
